description: AI is moving from tech labs into classrooms. Amazon has partnered with the Telangana School Education Department to introduce artificial intelligence literacy in government schools across the state.
body_lead: AI is moving from tech labs into classrooms. Amazon has partnered with the Telangana School Education Department to introduce artificial intelligence literacy in government schools across the state. The initiative, detailed in a statement reported on 1 July 2026, is expected to benefit around one million students annually under the Amazon-supported rollout and marks a major step in bringing emerging technology education to public school classrooms in Telangana.
